_instructions: Intentionally invalid template: no measured coordinates supplied. Calibrate original pixels. lane_rows contains [normalized_y,left_center,center_center,right_center] at increasing y. Restrict valid_frames or source_session/frame_range to reviewed camera geometry. footprints maps frame basenames to lists of {bbox:[pixel x1,y1,x2,y2],point:[normalized x,y],provenance:review evidence}; exact detection boxes must match. Only reviewed footprints yield KNOWN lanes. player_observations maps exact frames to {lane:0|1|2,movement:RUNNING|JUMPING|ROLLING|ON_TRAIN,transitioning:false|true,provenance:review evidence}. These observations do not propagate. No timing calibration or action-duration measurements are supplied.
